verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a single-email send as one POST to `/email`, authenticated with the `X-Postmark-Server-Token` header, and backs it with official SDKs, a complete TypeScript setup-to-production path, and a `POSTMARK_API_TEST` token for trying sends safely. A batch example returns a per-recipient `MessageID`, and community users report sending with plain curl POST requests. Missing for 10: an explicit list of the minimal required fields, evidence that the single-send response returns a MessageID (only the batch example shows it), and a verbatim copy-paste quickstart snippet for the single send.
